schema.text: Without a car, do you give up trying or find it very hard to pick people up with luggage at a station or airport?

ar.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: بدون سيارة، هل تتخلى عن المحاولة أو تجد صعوبة بالغة في استقبال أشخاص معهم أمتعة في محطة أو مطار؟

de.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Verzichten Sie ohne Auto darauf oder fällt es Ihnen sehr schwer, Menschen mit Gepäck am Bahnhof oder Flughafen abzuholen?

en.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Without a car, do you give up trying or find it very hard to pick people up with luggage at a station or airport?

fa.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: بدون خودرو، آیا از تلاش دست می‌کشید یا برایتان خیلی سخت است که افرادی را که چمدان دارند از ایستگاه یا فرودگاه بردارید؟

fr.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Sans voiture, renoncez-vous à essayer ou trouvez-vous très difficile de aller chercher des personnes avec des bagages à une gare ou à un aéroport ?

hu.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Autó nélkül lemond arról, vagy nagyon nehéznek találja, hogy csomaggal érkező embereket felvenni az állomáson vagy a repülőtéren?

it.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Senza auto, rinunci o fai molta fatica a andare a prendere persone con i bagagli in stazione o in aeroporto?

tr.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Arabanız olmadan, bir istasyondan veya havalimanından bagajlı kişileri almaktan vazgeçiyor veya bunu çok zor buluyor musunuz?
